sloka: रक्तोत्पल वनैः च अत्र मण्डिताः च हिरण्मयैः ।तरुण आदित्य संकाशा भान्ति तत्र जलाशयाः ॥४-४३-४०॥
transliteration: raktotpala vanaiḥ ca atra maṇḍitāḥ ca hiraṇmayaiḥ ।taruṇa āditya saṁkāśā bhānti tatra jalāśayāḥ ॥4-43-40॥

translations.english: 'Thereafter you will reach the country of UttaraKuru, a resort for those who have done meritorious deeds.There are lotus ponds with golden lotuses with bluish and greenish leaves.There are thousands of rivers adorned with red and night lotuses of gold.
translations.hindi: इन बॉसो के दने वे पॉ को इस तट से उस तट हृ; उस नदी के उस त्मा लोग रहा करते इ
